title: Butt of the joke: Trump impersonator mocks president at Canada press dinner
summary_full: Carney watches on as comedian lampoons US leader and his interest in men’s backsides at correspondents’ event OttawaCanada’s prime minister, Mark Carney, was joined on stage in Ottawa by a Donald Trump impersonator who mocked the US president to raucous laughter from a crowd of politicians and journalists at a parliamentary press gallery dinner on Saturday.With coiffed hair and an ill-fitting suit, comedian Mark Critch – who portrays the president on the sketch show This Hour Has 22 Minutes – danced on to the stage and lampooned the trade war Trump started as well as the president’s threats to annex Canada.
